response.title: what size portable power bank do i need
response.answer:
For most people, a 10,000–20,000 mAh portable power bank is the sweet spot. The right size depends on what you're charging and how long you'll be away from an outlet.

Power bank size guide

Estimates assume a modern smartphone with a roughly 5,000 mAh battery and account for charging losses.

Capacity isn't everything

There are two important specifications:

Capacity (mAh or Wh): Determines how many times you can charge your devices.

Output power (W): Determines charging speed and whether you can charge a laptop.

For phones, 20–30W is usually sufficient. For laptops, look for 65–100W USB-C Power Delivery or whatever your laptop requires.

For air travel, power banks up to 100 Wh (roughly 27,000 mAh at 3.7V) are generally permitted in carry-on baggage without airline approval. They aren't allowed in checked baggage.

For most people, a **10,000–20,000 mAh portable power bank** is the sweet spot. The right size depends on what you're charging and how long you'll be away from an outlet.

## Power bank size guide

| Capacity | Approx. phone charges | Best for |
|---|---|---|
| 5,000 mAh | 0.7–1 | Emergency backup |
| 10,000 mAh | 1.5–2 | Everyday carry |
| 20,000 mAh | 3–4 | Travel, long days |
| 30,000 mAh | 5–6 | Camping, multiple devices |
| 50,000 mAh | 8–10 | Extended off-grid use |

<text color="secondary" size="xs">Estimates assume a modern smartphone with a roughly 5,000 mAh battery and account for charging losses.</text>

## Capacity isn't everything

There are two important specifications:

- **Capacity (mAh or Wh):** Determines how many times you can charge your devices.
- **Output power (W):** Determines charging speed and whether you can charge a laptop.

For phones, 20–30W is usually sufficient. For laptops, look for 65–100W USB-C Power Delivery or whatever your laptop requires.

For air travel, power banks up to **100 Wh** (roughly 27,000 mAh at 3.7V) are generally permitted in carry-on baggage without airline approval. They aren't allowed in checked baggage.

    <box gap={1}>
      <label>What are you charging?</label>
      <radio-group direction="col" value={device} onChange={setDevice}>

        <radio value="laptop">Laptop</radio>
        <radio value="multiple">Multiple devices</radio>
      </radio-group>
    </box>
    <divider color="subtle"/>
    <box gap={1}>
      <label>How long without access to an outlet?</label>
      <radio-group direction="col" value={duration} onChange={setDuration}>
        <radio value="day">One day</radio>
        <radio value="weekend">2–3 days</radio>
        <radio value="extended">4+ days</radio>
      </radio-group>
    </box>
    <divider color="subtle"/>
    <box gap={1}>
      <label>How heavily do you use your devices?</label>
      <radio-group direction="col" value={usage} onChange={setUsage}>
        <radio value="light">Light</radio>
        <radio value="normal">Normal</radio>
        <radio value="heavy">Heavy (gaming, video, navigation)</radio>
      </radio-group>
    </box>
    <button block submit>Find my ideal power bank size <icon name="arrow-right" inline/></button>
  </form>
</box>
